entities.summary: "Million Dollar Baby" is a song by American singer and rapper Tommy Richman. It was released on April 26, 2024, through ISO Supremacy, PULSE Records and Concord with distribution by Universal Music Group. It was written by Richman with production credits from Max Vossberg, Jonah Roy, MannyVelli, Sparkheem, Kavi, and Gidi. The song became the longest running number-one song on the TikTok Billboard Top 50 chart, staying at the top spot for ten consecutive weeks starting in May 2024.
